method: Direct current source review of the listed named-import wrapper call branches and enclosing entry points

rows.role: Retained restore-journal maintenance metadata for archived replacement readiness, fresh-project preparation/publication, owner adoption and resumed snapshot readiness.
rows.guards: Verified independent backup, freshness/layout checks, exact source/incoming/outgoing bindings, live maintenance scope and owner continuity; ACTIVE requires integrity, logical parity and attachment validation.

rows.role: readBytes for external/portable validation input only when operational selection does not recognize the requested identity.
rows.guards: Outer read snapshot selects existing canonical authority; missing selected rows report missing, not fallback; safe path, JSON bounds and subsequent domain/schema validation.

rows.role: readBytes for explicit portable receipt or legacy source inspection; canonical receipt text selected when native identity recognized.
rows.guards: Operational requests select existing project scope; selected missing receipt errors; contained paths, JSON limits and receipt semantic validation.

rows.role: readBytes hashes external material evidence after canonical binding selection.
rows.guards: Existing native scope selected; canonical missing/changed binding stays canonical; external input containment retained.

rows.role: readBytes hashes external regular material evidence after canonical binding selection.
rows.guards: Canonical source binding first; external lstat/realpath containment/type checks; errors map to unsafe revalidation.

limitations: Named-import direct calls only; no whole transitive or arbitrary external effect proof.
Legacy writer exclusion still requires operator action.
Source review is distinct from test evidence and publication authority.
